requirements: Network connection to SMTP server (firewall allows port 25/587/465)
smtpConfiguration: Access Brother Web-Based Management at http://[printer-ip]
Navigate to Administrator tab > Email/IFAX Settings
Enter SMTP Server Address: smtp.office365.com or smtp.gmail.com
Check 'SMTP Server Requires Authentication' if needed
Enter SMTP Username (usually full email address)
Enter SMTP Password (use app password for Gmail)
Set 'From' address (sender email - must be valid)
Configure SSL/TLS: None (port 25), STARTTLS (port 587), or SSL (port 465)
Set Maximum Email Size if server has limits (default: 2MB)
Use 'Send Test Email' button to verify settings
authenticationSetup: Office 365: smtp.office365.com, port 587, STARTTLS, use full email@domain.com as username
Gmail: smtp.gmail.com, port 587, STARTTLS, enable 2FA and create app-specific password
Exchange on-premise: Use internal server address (mail.company.local), port 25 or 587
Generic SMTP: Check with IT for server address, port, and authentication method
For port 465: Select SSL, for port 587: Select STARTTLS
Some servers require 'From' address to match authenticated account
testProcedure: In web interface: Email/IFAX Settings > Send Test Email
If failed, check touchscreen for error code
Common errors: Authentication Failed, Connection Timeout, Relay Denied
From device touchscreen: Scan > Email > Address Book > Select recipient > Start scan

requirements: Network file share (SMB/CIFS or FTP server)
Valid credentials with write permissions to target folder
smbConfiguration: Navigate to Administrator > Scan to Network (or Scan to FTP/Network)
Click 'Add' to create new scan destination
Enter Profile Name (displayed on touchscreen): Marketing Scans
Set File Name: Prefix (scan), Suffix (date/time), Extension (.pdf)
Choose File Type: PDF (recommended), JPEG, TIFF, PDF/A
Choose Color Mode: Auto, Color, Grayscale, Black & White
Set Duplex: Simplex or Duplex (2-sided scanning)
Click 'Test' to verify connection and permissions
ftpConfiguration: Brother MFC-L5900DW supports FTP scanning (older protocol)
Access web interface > Administrator > Scan to FTP
Enter FTP Server Address: ftp.company.com or 192.168.1.100
Enter Username and Password for FTP account
Enter Upload Directory path on FTP server: /scans/incoming
Choose Passive Mode if behind firewall (recommended)
Set file naming and scan settings same as SMB
Note: FTP transmits passwords in clear text - use FTPS if available
authenticationSetup: Active Directory: Use DOMAIN\\username format (e.g., CONTOSO\\scanservice)
Local server account: Use SERVERNAME\\username format
Verify account has write permissions to target folder:
- Share permissions: Read/Write on share properties
- NTFS permissions: Modify or Write on folder security tab
Test credentials manually: From another PC, try creating file in target folder
Best practice: Create dedicated service account for scanner (not personal account)
For user-prompted auth: Configure 'Authentication Required' on device touchscreen

requirements: USB flash drive formatted as FAT32 (up to 32GB) or exFAT (larger drives)

USB port on front or side of device

Insert USB drive into device's USB port (usually front panel)
Touchscreen displays 'USB Memory Detected' or 'USB Connected'
- File Type: PDF (recommended), JPEG, TIFF, PDF/A
- Color: Auto, Color, Grayscale, Black & White
Load document in ADF (up to 50 sheets) or place on scanner glass
Touchscreen: Press 'Eject USB' or 'Remove USB' before physically removing drive
Files saved to root directory of USB drive with timestamp naming: BRHXXXXXX.pdf
supportedFormats: TIFF (single or multi-page, uncompressed, large files)
PDF/A (archival format, good for long-term storage)
notes: FAT32 has 4GB file size limit - use exFAT for large scan jobs
Scan resolution affects file size: 200dpi ≈ 1MB per page, 600dpi ≈ 10MB per page
PDF recommended for documents, JPEG for photos/images
Always use 'Eject' function before removing USB to prevent corruption
